note: Non-destructive organization. Original source files remain in place; copies are organized under docs/guide. Missing storyboard frames are reported, never fabricated.

scenes.narration: The word `cat` entered computing through a disagreement over which way up a cat goes.
This was not initially considered difficult. Cats corrected the record.
A cat regards whichever surface it occupies as the upper surface.
Turning the cat over merely gives the universe a new upper surface.
The Egyptians discovered this and mistook standardization for divinity.
The principle spread.
Observational research continued, mostly because the subject refused peer review.
Physicists tested gravity. Gravity worked. The cat declined to participate.
Further studies established a strong institutional preference for night.
Food selection was classified as constitutional law.
Hierarchy was accepted only when the cat occupied its highest point.
Computing shortened concatenate to `cat`; Unix writes file contents in sequence.
The computing term **move** derives from elevator law.
Movement meant a successful change in where passengers intended to be.
Pressing a button established intent.
Closing the doors established consent.
No further evidence was required.
Then one elevator interpreted **UP** as a continuing instruction.
It passed the requested floor.
Then all the other floors.
Having exhausted the building, it continued upward.
The city objected.
The atmosphere objected later.
The inquiry changed the definition. Unix kept the word `mv`.
Package management began as the profession of delivering one thing.
Packages were granted the right to arrive with what they needed.
The first package requested an additional package.
Things began to arrive.
Then more things.
Warehouses became factories.
Factories acquired supply chains, which acquired relationships.
Balance was introduced as a theoretical objective.
The original package remained somewhere in the resulting economy.
A specialist search department was formed.
Confidence fluctuated according to departmental requirements.
Modern package managers automate the whole thing. `pkg install` resolves and installs dependencies.
`find` is named after the Cartographical Disaster of Nth.
Maps had to show every legitimate route. Comprehensiveness required detours.
Detours required signs; signs required a definition of forward.
Maps began including travellers who had not decided to travel.
Routes eventually outnumbered destinations.
Cartographers abolished routes. Unix `find` asks where to start and what to match.
